rules.title: Anti-Eviction Act (good cause for non-renewal of lease)
rules.requirement: Landlords of residential rental properties may not fail to renew any written or oral lease unless they have good cause; the grounds are listed in the Eviction section of the guide. Owner-occupied two- and three-family dwellings, motels or hotels, and transient or seasonal units are excluded.

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: owner occupied two or three family dwellings
owner occupied two or three family dwellings

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental properties and covers both written and oral leases.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempt are owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings, motels or hotels, and transient or seasonal units.

rules.quoted_span: No landlord of residential rental properties except t hose in owner occupied two or three family dwellings, motels or hotels, transient, or seasonal units may fail to renew any lease, regardless of whether it is written or oral unless they have good cause not to renew the lease.
